scope: All ordinary body-flow citations, their nearby substantive claims, bibliographic identities, natural bibliography coverage, canonical TeX/BibTeX consistency, and the manuscript's exact finite-audit assertion were checked; mathematical correctness remains bound to the accepted math audit.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage frozen claim extraction followed by claim-level inspection of authoritative arXiv full text, an institutional publication record, the supplied primary PDF, DOI metadata, canonical BibTeX/AUX/BBL consistency, and a fresh byte-exact local finite-audit replay.
